Bid Summary.value: The State of Maryland Treasurer's Office is seeking a refresh of laptops to accommodate MD529 employees who have been included in the staff. The procurement objective is to acquire 30 units of Dell Latitude 5550 laptops that are Microsoft Copilot ready along with 30 units of Dell Thunderbolt 4 Docks (Model WD22TB4). Deliverables include the hardware items accompanied by a 3-year Dell Limited Hardware Warranty extended for all machines purchased, with a warranty certificate or affidavit to be presented upon award. All items are due by June 10, 2024.

sources.quote: Office is in need of a refresh of laptops and must acquire enough laptops to accommodate MD529 employees who have been included in our staff as of June 1, 2023.
